# OrderFlow

OrderFlow is a small e-commerce order-management system built with Node.js and JavaScript. It supports product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout, inventory management, orders, and reporting.

## Features

- Product catalog with duplicate-ID protection and data validation
- Shopping cart with quantity updates, removal, and totals
- Inventory checks and deduction during checkout
- Order creation, retrieval, and cancellation with inventory restoration
- Sales reporting including totals, order counts, best sellers, and remaining inventory
- Command-line demonstration

## Project structure

```text
orderflow/
├── package.json
├── README.md
├── index.js
├── src/
│   ├── catalog.js
│   ├── cart.js
│   ├── inventory.js
│   ├── orders.js
│   ├── checkout.js
│   ├── reports.js
│   └── errors.js
└── test/
    ├── catalog.test.js
    ├── cart.test.js
    ├── inventory.test.js
    ├── orders.test.js
    └── checkout.test.js
```

## Usage

Run the automated tests:

```bash
npm test
node --test test/*.test.js
```

Run the command-line demonstration:

```bash
node index.js
```

The demonstration creates products, adds cart items, completes checkout, displays an order, and prints a sales report.

## Requirements

- Node.js 18 or newer
- No database, external API, paid service, or credentials required
